coverage_notes.screening: No qualifying newly reported essential U.S./territory healthcare-access loss or verified reopening found since the prior completed heartbeat. Searches surfaced previously announced Illinois maternity suspensions and older Michigan behavioral-health service suspension, historical rural closures and proposals. Official Guam October 17 typhoon outpatient notice and October 19 reopening preceded this observation window; government CNMI health-services bulletin content was older/undated for current observation. Foreign, historical, proposed, and nonclinical stories excluded.

coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted web searches completed; no access/search failures observed. Search indexing and local-reporting latency mean absence of a confirmed update is not proof no change occurred. No direct primary production queue review was needed for zero new candidates.
coverage_notes.controls: Observation and single private-watch heartbeat only. No approval, publication, production mutation, schedule alteration, or task disabling.
